correctness.rationale: For prime-power q≥3 and integer d≥3, Fourier positivity and the coordinate-permutation/nonzero-scaling group average reduce the unrestricted Turán mass over B₂={wt≤2} to radial degree-two Krawtchouk polynomials with E_Bin(d,(q−1)/q)[P]=1, P(k)≥0 on integer 0≤k≤d. Put μ=d(q−1)/q, r=⌊μ⌋, θ=μ−r and D=d(q−1)/q²−θ(1−θ)>0. The feasible P=(k−r)(k−r−1)/D has mass P(0)=r(r+1)/D. Independently checked the exact dual identity P(0)≤M E[P] from M E[P]−P(0)=αP(r)+βP(r+1), β>0, α≥0, α=0 iff d≡1(mod q). Strict dual equality gives unique radial P off the congruence and the closed segment between successive adjacent-root quadratics when d≡1(mod q). Exact rational independent checks for q∈{3,4,5,7,11,16}, 3≤d≤24 corroborated identities and congruence boundaries. The proof, not those tests, covers all allowed prime powers and dimensions. No statement classifies all NONradial maximizers.
